crossRefs.note: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

translations.web: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”
translations.bsb: Some claimed that he was, but others said, “No, he just looks like him.” But the man kept saying, “I am the one.”
translations.kjv: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am
translations.asv: Others said, It is he: others said, No, but he is like him. He said, I am he.
